name: merging-bubbles

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the merged peanut shape largest, with both icons and the centre plus.

tagline: Two logo bubbles joined by a liquid waist, a plus floating between them.
summary: A small graphic of two circular bubbles fused into one peanut shape, each holding a supplied icon with a faint plus between them. It is used to show two tools or services connecting into a single integration.
appearance: A wide dark blob shaped like two circles fused by a curved neck, with a thin light border and a faint outer glow. A database cylinder sits in the left lobe, a sparkle in the right, and a small faint plus marks the middle.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds; the two icons and the plus stay fixed in place.
demo_content: A database icon merged with a sparkle above the line "Your data, meet your model" and a Postgres caption.
search_phrases: two logos joined into one shape
use_when: A section should show two tools combining into one workflow without spelling the pairing out in a list.
avoid_when: It carries no text, so the pairing means nothing unless a caption explains which two things merged.
customise: Pass any two icons as startIcon and endIcon, choose one of four sizes, toggle the centre plus, and colour it through the surrounding text classes.
weight_why: One inline vector of a few paths plus two icon slots; nothing runs at runtime.

a11y.note: The graphic's only title reads "Outer glow/shadow", so screen readers get no sense of what the two icons stand for.

issues: The centre plus is very faint and nearly lost between the two icons.
The main SVG's title is "Outer glow/shadow", which mislabels the whole graphic to screen readers.
polish_why: Smooth custom merged shape and crisp icons; the centre plus is faint and the title mislabelled.
title: Merging Bubbles
